notes.text: Shared spaces take photos and cards: a photographed Canopy Concept Card arrives with its meaning. Ask Marianne for a reading lays out cards for where your conversations are, each tied to its moments.
Say Share One Button to send anyone your app, a shared space and the film
Send link now gives friends their own One Button with your shared space already open
Double tap the button for the camera. The camera icons are gone: one button again.

Hold the button, speak, let go: it goes. A tap still starts and stops a recording. The camera has its own icon. "Call Simon" starts recording, then opens Phone, WhatsApp, Signal or Telegram, and remem
Friends on iPhone: the Conversations button shows on the first visit, lists what you shared with them, and a home-screen app without a sign-in asks for their link.
Listening to key ideas now uses the subspace already on that theme (and replays at once when nothing is new), or makes a new subspace for it, offering conversations from other spaces to add.

Say "play me key ideas around" anything: One Button gathers it from all your conversations and plays it idea by idea. Press the button and say jump to an idea, next, back or more; anything else is kep

The podcast now plays through Android itself (with the new app build): it carries on with the screen off, with Back, Play, Forward and More on the lock screen and earbuds. On a subspace page, Listen i
Subspaces: the podcast now plays on a subspace's own page too. Make a subspace from conversations in any of your spaces; ones from another space wait for a yes from the people in them.
Claude's answers come as one notice. Tap it to read every new answer on one page; earlier ones are underneath, and Settings has Claude's answers any time.
The space podcast is simpler: a short introduction, then the moments straight from the recordings, each whole sentences. Back, Play and Forward, with the list of parts to jump to.

Every shared space (and subspace) opens with a podcast: a spoken synopsis in the Metamyth voice and the best moments from the recordings. Press More of this, or say more after a moment, to hear a wide

In a shared space, Ask can read all your shared conversations; tick findings and projects from the answer and put them in the space or a subspace. In a seed space, link a conversation by browsing your
Leaving a shared space always works: the phone's back gesture closes it, the cross goes right out, and links inside never replace the app.
Tap a project to open its page. Its tasks come first: new ones marked, each with Done, Keep here, Move to, Front page or Drop.
On iPhone: a Conversations button lists your recorded conversations, and Record a conversation records until you stop, keeping the screen awake.
What's new sits highlighted on the features page, with Works or Not quite on each change; Not quite sends a fix request to the laptop.
Flow funding grew from your conversations with Simon, and he is a member automatically.
This list: every update now says in one line what changed. Updates with nothing to see reload quietly.
Tap a Claude answer (yellow bar, Claude card or lock screen) to read it in full, with Share and Got it.
The yellow bar shows today's wins (tap for the list). Task dots are no longer cut off on the left.
Notices like 'Claude answered' appear in the yellow bar instead of popping up.
From build 19, app updates download and open the installer from inside the app.
Rows fit the phone screen: task ticks and the contact form no longer run off the side.
A One Button key opens every space you are in, with no account code.
Main screen: seed spaces, then conversation spaces with their projects inside, then people. Calls: say 'call' and pick Phone, WhatsApp or Signal.
